title: converting a date and time between time zones

kind.why: A short, exact program with no judgment in it: check the three inputs, convert with Node's own time zone data, write the answer. A harness reading one skill carries it.

speed.why: It is one calculation on data already in Node, with nothing to wait on.

data.limit: reads only the date and time and the two time zone names it is given; keeps nothing between runs and sends nothing anywhere
data.why: It reaches no outside system and stores no record.

trust.limit: takes a job from any caller; it only computes and answers, and refuses rather than guesses
trust.why: Nothing it does changes anything outside its own reply.

drivers.says: It reaches no outside system and uses no model; Node's own time zone data is enough.
drivers.from: It reaches no outside system and uses no model: Node's own time zone data is enough.

drivers.says: It refuses a name it does not know and never guesses a time zone from a city or country name.
drivers.from: it refuses to guess a time zone from a city or country name

formats.convention: a calendar date and wall clock time, as 2026-11-12T09:30, seconds optional, no offset
formats.why: A person or an agent says when, in the first place's own clock time.

formats.convention: an IANA time zone name, such as America/Denver
formats.why: The place the date and time is in.

formats.convention: an IANA time zone name, such as Europe/Paris
a header of the fields from, to, datetime_from, datetime_to and difference_hours, then one sentence saying the same in words; a refusal is the header field refused and one sentence saying why
formats.why: A person reads it, and an agent can take the header fields.

skills.name: convert-time
skills.responsibility: Converts a date and time in one IANA time zone to the same moment in a second, with the difference in hours, or refuses.
skills.script: Checks the date and time and both zone names, converts the moment with Node's own time zone data, and writes the answer or the refusal.

parts.name: input checker
parts.responsibility: Finds what is missing, refuses a date and time that is not real, and refuses a name that is unknown or is a city or country name.

parts.name: zone converter
parts.responsibility: Finds the moment the wall clock time names in the first zone, refusing a skipped time and taking the earlier of a doubled one, and gives that moment's clock time in the second zone and the difference in hours.

parts.name: answer writer
parts.responsibility: Writes the conversion or the refusal as the Markdown answer.

flow.data: the date and time and the two places
flow.says: The caller asks for the moment in the second place.

flow.data: the date and time and the two places
flow.says: The harness starts the script with the job's inputs.

flow.data: the checked date and time and zone names
flow.says: Only inputs that passed every check are converted.

flow.data: the converted date and time and the difference in hours
flow.says: The converter hands over the result or the reason it refused.
The answer goes back as the reply, through the harness.

decisions.decided: A program does the whole conversion with Node's own time zone data, and no model is called
decisions.context: Converting a moment between time zones is exact arithmetic over the time zone database, which Node carries.
decisions.why: The answer has one right value, so code gives it every time, testably, at no cost.

alternatives.option: A model that reads the request and works out the time
alternatives.why_not: It could guess, and the person said it uses no model.

alternatives.option: A time zone service on the network
alternatives.why_not: It would be an outside system, and Node's own data is enough.

consequences: The job is control script, intelligence none and contract full.
Its answers are as current as the time zone data of the Node it runs on.

decisions.decided: Accept only Area/Location names and UTC, checked against Node's own data
decisions.context: Node's data also knows old single-word aliases such as Japan and Egypt, which read as country names.
decisions.why: A single-word name other than UTC is refused as a city or country name, so nothing is guessed from one.

alternatives.why_not: Japan or Egypt would be taken as a time zone, which reads as guessing from a country name.

consequences: A caller writes Asia/Tokyo, not Japan.

decisions.context: One conversion, read by a person or taken by an agent.
decisions.why: The reply is ready at once, and a short header lets an agent read the fields.

alternatives.why_not: A person reads the answer as often as code does.

consequences: Its header fields are fixed so a test can hold them.
